name: 37. Bedrock Invoke Route Anthropic-Native Content Blocks (#5560)
description: Regression for #5560. The Bedrock InvokeModel route (POST /bedrock/model/{modelId}/invoke) accepts Claude's native Anthropic Messages format for the request body, but BedrockContentBlock only recognized Converse's field-name-discriminated shape (toolUse/toolResult/image.source.bytes), not Anthropic's type-discriminated shape (type:"image"/"tool_use"/"tool_result"). Unknown JSON fields are silently ignored by the JSON decoder, so every non-text content block deserialized to an all-nil BedrockContentBlock with no error, and was then silently skipped downstream - only text blocks coincidentally matched field names between the two shapes and survived. Case 1 pins the image half of the bug using the issue's own reproduction shape: a request with an image block plus a fallback instruction ('answer NOIMAGE if you cannot see any image') must not get the NOIMAGE sentinel, since a fixed ingress actually delivers the image to the model. Case 2 pins the tool_use/tool_result half: a conversation history already containing a completed tool call and its result must not cause the model to blindly re-invoke the same tool (the exact stop_reason: tool_use defect observed in the issue), because it now actually sees the prior tool_result instead of a dropped/empty turn. Case 3 pins the same image defect on the streaming ingress (POST .../invoke-with-response-stream), since both invoke routes parse the request body through the same BedrockContentBlock deserialization before diverging into streaming vs. non-streaming response generation.
